prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Denver for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, the injuries, whether liability is disputed, the type of recovery you need, and what kind of working relationship you want. I can help you find the best fit if you tell me more about your situation (details below). Meanwhile, here’s practical guidance so you can choose a strong Denver attorney quickly.

Quick questions so I can give targeted recommendations
- Where in Denver (ZIP or neighborhood) are you located or where did the accident occur?
- Were you injured? Serious injuries or only vehicle damage?
- Is liability disputed? Was the other driver cited or uninsured?
- Any involvement of commercial vehicles, rideshare (Uber/Lyft), DUI, or catastrophic injury?
- Do you prefer a large firm with trial resources or a smaller attorney who’ll personally handle your case?

How to define “best” — key criteria to look for
- Experience with car-accident personal injury cases in Colorado (trial experience if your case may go to court)
- Track record of settlements/verdicts for injuries similar to yours
- Good client communication and availability
- Positive client reviews and peer recognition (Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell)
- Operates on contingency fee (no upfront cost; lawyer gets a percentage if you recover)
- Clear fee agreement and transparency about costs, medical liens, and timelines

Where to find and vet Denver PI lawyers
- Colorado Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service
- Super Lawyers and Best Lawyers directories
- Martindale‑Hubbell peer ratings and AV Preeminent ratings
- Local reviews on Google/Yelp and client testimonials
- Ask friends/family or other attorneys (e.g., a family lawyer or employment lawyer) for referrals

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled? What were the outcomes?
- Do you handle cases personally or pass them to associates? Who will be my main contact?
- What is your fee structure and what costs would I be responsible for?
- Do you have trial experience in Denver courts? Have you handled cases against the insurer involved?
- What’s your estimated timeline and likely range of recovery for my case?
- Can you provide references from former clients?

Immediate steps to protect your claim
- Get prompt medical care and follow doctors’ orders (important to prove injury and causation)
- Preserve evidence: photos, videos, repair estimates, police report, witness contacts
- Don’t give recorded statements or sign releases with the insurer before speaking to a lawyer
- Note deadlines: Colorado generally has a 2-year statute of limitations for personal injury claims

If you want, tell me your ZIP and a few facts about the crash and injuries and I’ll suggest 3–5 Denver attorneys or firms (with notes on why each might fit your case).
